title: SynthBio: A Case Study in Human-AI Collaborative Curation of Text Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Balancing the dataset by uniformly sampling male, female, and non-binary identities, measuring pronoun distributions, evaluating structure-to-text generation performance across gender subgroups, and conducting fairness audits for pronoun consistency.

Curating the dataset by sampling from diverse countries, comparing the geographic distribution of birthplaces to global population statistics, auditing for Western-centric attributes, and evaluating model performance across different nationalities.

Selecting a mix of the most common (e.g., scientist) and least common (e.g., mountaineer, spy) Wikipedia notability types, and evaluating language model generation performance across these different occupations to test for tail-distribution memorization.
